credits.title: The Healer
credits.overview: In a city governed by shadows, a blind acupuncturist lives a life of quiet ritual, using heightened senses to mend bodies the world has broken. Once a weapon trained to destroy, The Healer traded violence for peace — until Soly, a young patient he vowed to protect, becomes the target of ruthless gang boss Dandy Lynch.

credits.title: Lords of War
credits.overview: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

credits.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
credits.overview: After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Betelgeuse, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Afterlife.

credits.title: Boca do Inferno
credits.overview: A shy Portuguese poet and an exuberant English occultist meet up in Lisbon in 1930. When the last one disappears, an English detective begins a thorough investigation: was it a suicide, as reported. Or a homicide? credits.title: Petroleum Spirit
credits.overview: A surreal road movie about a partially deaf teenager hitting the road in a beat up Lada to find the father who abandoned him at birth. The stunning feature film debut of acclaimed commercials writer/director Rob Sanders.

credits.title: Tank 432
credits.overview: With nowhere else to hide, a group of mercenaries and their prisoners take cover inside a long abandoned Bulldog tank. credits.title: Apocalypse Pompeii
credits.overview: When a former Special Ops commando visits Pompeii, his wife and daughter are trapped as Mt. Vesuvius erupts with massive force. While his family fights to survive the deadly onslaught of heat and lava, he enlists his former teammates in a daring operation beneath the ruins of the city of Pompeii.
